title: 第1章 人类加载中
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【人类加载中……】

【投放区域初始化成功】

【请玩家为自己取个名字】

纳斯达克敲完钟，李知谢绝所有邀请关了机，特意给自己留了一天休息时间，窝在家里打游戏。

最后一张时光老头已经出现在牌库。

电脑和眼前却同时一黑。

李知死死抱住键盘：“还我三星五费！！！”

【玩家“还我三星五费！！！”载入初始世界】

【天赋生成中……】

【天赋:D牌(按键盘D键可刷新出五张卡牌)】

【备注：玩家天赋生成于玩家此刻最强烈的情绪或者执念】

下一秒，李知抱着键盘出现在一个陌生屋子里。

痛心疾首的表情瞬间化为警惕，第一时间观察周围：

不到十平，木质结构，头顶漏风，把唯一一张门吹得啪啪响。

不对，她刚才听到“D牌”两个字。

好像也看到了。

不等她深究，又一行文字出现在眼前：

【第一批人类（18~55岁）全部加载成功，欢迎加入飞舟求生游戏】

【请谨记以下游戏规则：

1、这是一个真实的世界，玩家死亡便是真正的死亡。

2、飞舟是庇护所也是载具，请尽全力升级强化飞舟。

3、飞行高度与资源、危险、气候关联，请酌情升降。

4、新手保护期内，不会遇到外部袭击以及自然灾害。

5、飞舟自带云网，云网可以打捞物资，也可能带来危险。

6、所有人起点相同，天赋不同，请最大限度利用开发自己的天赋。

7、更多信息请查看玩家面板。】

文字慢慢淡出。

李知脸上疑惑、震惊、怀疑等情绪交替出现。

最后，她一把推开被风吹得哐当响的木门。

门外有大概一米五宽的走廊，走廊围着整个木屋建造，在门的左边有一个白色渔网状的东西。

云层如雾，围绕在木屋周围，栏杆的空隙里，可以看到高空下的山岭。

这高度，至少五百米。

李知面无表情退回了木屋。

砰地一声关上门。

挪着发软的腿一屁股坐在铁架床上。

——倒不是接受不了求生游戏。

她就是开科技公司的，十分清楚外面环境的真实度是科技伪装不了的。

求生游戏和全民穿越，她也不算陌生。

上学的时候看过这类型小说，刚毕业还投资过类似的游戏公司，她自己也是开游戏公司起家的。

说起来，她可能比99%的人都会更快适应这里。

但是……

她恐高啊！

穿到海上穿到树林甚至荒野求生，她都能比现在更平静的接受这一切！

李知调整呼吸，在吸气-屏息-吐气的过程中，慢慢镇定下来。

事已至此，解决问题才是关键。

一般小说或者游戏主角被拉入求生游戏第一时间干什么来着？

李知想了想。

应该是收集信息。

环境信息她已经收集得差不多了。

李知目光转到右下角闪烁的【区域聊天】，却没有第一时间

渐渐理清思绪。

目前最关键的只有三点：升级庇护所、搜集物资以及利用好自己的天赋。

思索着，她

【玩家：还我三星五费！！！】

【等级：1（查看属性）】

【种族等级：D-（60/10~？）】

【庇护所：漂浮木屋（升级详情）】

[Humans are loading...]

[The delivery area is initialized successfully]

[Players are asked to give themselves a name]

After the Nasdaq bell rang, Li Zhi declined all invitations and turned off his phone. He deliberately gave himself a day of rest and stayed at home playing games.

The last old man of time has appeared in the card library.

The computer and the eyes immediately went dark at the same time.

Li Zhi hugged the keyboard tightly: "Give me five Samsungs!!!"

[Player "Give me three stars for five fees!!!" Loading the initial world]

[Talent is being generated...]

[Talent: D card (press the D key on the keyboard to refresh five cards)]

[Note: Player talents are generated from the player’s strongest emotions or obsessions at the moment]

The next second, Li Zhi appeared in a strange room holding the keyboard.

The distressed expression instantly turned into vigilance, and he immediately observed his surroundings:

Less than ten square meters, it was a wooden structure, and the wind leaked from the top of the head, causing the only door to crackle.

No, she just heard the word "D card".

I think I saw it too.

Before she could dig deeper, another line of text appeared in front of her:

[The first batch of humans (18~55 years old) have all been loaded successfully, welcome to join the flying boat survival game]

[Please remember the following game rules:

1. This is a real world, and the death of the player is the real death.

2. The flying boat is both a shelter and a vehicle. Please do your best to upgrade and strengthen the flying boat.

3. Flight altitude is related to resources, dangers, and climate. Please ascend or descend as appropriate.

4. During the protection period, novices will not encounter external attacks or natural disasters.

5. The flying boat comes with a cloud network. The cloud network can salvage materials, but it may also bring danger.

6. Everyone has the same starting point but different talents. Please make the most of your talents.

7. Please check the player panel for more information.】

The text slowly fades out.

Doubt, shock, suspicion and other emotions appeared alternately on Li Zhi's face.

Finally, she pushed open the wooden door that was rattled by the wind.

There is a corridor about one and a half meters wide outside the door. The corridor is built around the entire wooden house. There is a white fishnet-like thing on the left side of the door.

Clouds like fog surround the wooden house, and through the gaps in the railings, you can see the mountains high in the sky.

This height is at least five hundred meters.

Li Zhi returned to the cabin expressionlessly.

Slam the door.

He moved his weak legs and sat down on the iron frame bed.

——It’s not that I can’t accept survival games.

She runs a technology company and knows very well that technology cannot disguise the reality of the outside environment.

She is no stranger to survival games and time travel.

She had read novels of this type when she was in school, and she had invested in a similar game company just after graduation. She also started a game company herself.

Speaking of which, she might adapt here faster than 99% of people.

But...

She is afraid of heights!

Traveling to the sea, into the woods or even in the wilderness to survive, she can accept it all more calmly than now!

Li Zhi adjusted his breathing and slowly calmed down in the process of inhaling - holding his breath - exhaling.

Now that the matter is over, solving the problem is the key.

What does the protagonist of a novel or game do when he is pulled into a survival game?

Li Zhi thought for a while.

It should be about gathering information.

She has collected almost all the environmental information.

Li Zhi turned his attention to the flashing [Regional Chat] in the lower right corner, but did not immediately

Gradually clear your thoughts.

At present, there are only three most critical points: upgrading the shelter, collecting supplies, and making good use of your talents.
